programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.desc: Comedy drama directed by and starring Kathy Bates. programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: Romantic comedy, starring Jason Biggs and Isla Fisher. Loved-up Anderson is in the middle of proposing to his girlfriend when the unthinkable happens and she dies. He sinks into depression and is convinced he will never find love again. However, a year later, he impulsively pops the question to a waitress and she agrees. Joe Pantoliano also features.

programme.title: Earthsea
programme.desc: Based on the eponymous series of books by Ursula K. LeGuin, Earthsea centers on a young man whose destiny lies in his own hands; a man with the power to become the greatest sorcerer his world has ever known. The youthful protagonist, Ged, realises he possesses endless magical powers, and embarks on an adventure to master his mystical abilities. His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Russian political elite hires American consultants to help with President Yeltsin's re-election campaign when his approval rating is down to single digits.

programme.title: Swamp Devil
programme.desc: A young girl finds out some disturbing supernatural truths about her father, who has been a suspect to multiple murder cases.

programme.title: The Day of the Triffids
programme.desc: Sci-fi mini-series based on the classic novel by John Wyndham. Dougray Scott stars as Bill Masen, an expert on a species of plant that killed his mother in the 1970s. The species, known as triffids, can be used as an alternative fuel and help end global warming. Unfortunately, triffids are extremely dangerous. They are mobile, carnivorous, intelligent, and wreak havoc wherever they go. Starring Joely Richardson, Brian Cox, Vanessa Redgrave and Eddie Izzard.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Eurolyga. "Maccabi" - "Real"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolyga. "Virtus" - "Panathinaikos"

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: A dangerous heatwave surges across India, which means more deadly snakes are on the move looking for shelter. Simon and Sioux join Snake Shyam and Gowri Shanker to battle the heat and rescue hiding snakes. The team tries to rescue a spectacled cobra from a water pit and a deadly Russell's viper hiding in a bookstore. For the first time in 30 years, Simon tails and rescues a king cobra by himself!

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: Simon, Sioux, and Mbali split up because the calls keep coming in. Sioux and Mbali face a feisty mamba on their own, while Simon catches a second black mamba solo. Then, Simon teaches Mbali how to bag her first spitting cobra while Sioux focuses on an elusive boomslang. Finally, Simon rescues a huge snake hidden in a shed while Mbali and Sioux contain a feisty, cornered black mamba.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Wild Mongolia: Land of Extremes
programme.desc: Landlocked and bordering both China and Russia, Mongolia is a land of extreme habitats. From the challenging environment of the Gobi desert situated on a mounain plateau to the vast grasslands of the Mongolian Steppe, from the Altai mountains to the Taiga forest in the north of the country, this land is home to some of the hardiest and most resilient animals on the planet. The show explores the topography these distinct environments and chronicles how the wildlife has evolved and adapted so that they can either live with littel access to water or else become totally dependent on grass for their survival.

A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Nigel Marven: Wild Central America
programme.desc: Join affable presenter Nigel Marven as he discovers the colourful and varied wildlife of Costa Rica. Meet Scarlet Macaws on the Osa Peninsula, playful Spotted Dolphins in the Gulf of Dulce, a "Christmas Tree" Eyelash Palm Pitviper, baby Leatherback Turtles on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast and a group of colourful kings in the north of the country. All this and more as Nigel meets both locals and scientists keen to share their beautiful country and wildlife with him.

programme.title: Nigel Marven: Wild Central America
programme.desc: Nigel Marven explores the stunningly beautiful country of Guatemala, uncovering a wealth of wildlife, dramatic scenery and ancient Maya history along the way. Join him to see the world's most beautiful lake, Central America's most colourful pitviper and incredible views from the 'top of the Maya world'. There are Quetzals, jays and orchids in the cloud forests and venomous lizards in the arid interior. Crocodiles keep watch in the rivers and rare turtles surprise our host.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Wild Mongolia: Land of Extremes
programme.desc: Landlocked and bordering both China and Russia, Mongolia is a land of extreme habitats. From the challenging environment of the Gobi desert situated on a mounain plateau to the vast grasslands of the Mongolian Steppe, from the Altai mountains to the Taiga forest in the north of the country, this land is home to some of the hardiest and most resilient animals on the planet. The show explores the topography these distinct environments and chronicles how the wildlife has evolved and adapted so that they can either live with littel access to water or else become totally dependent on grass for their survival.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Cats of India
programme.desc: India's big cats remain the soul of the Indian terrain - acting as charismatic ambassadors for the protection of their ecosystems. In Episode 1, watch the snow leopard guard his kill from an unrelenting red fox and follow the lives of the last surviving Asiatic lions of Gir.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixer lend a helping paw to a variety of canine clients. Fifteen small-town celebrity chihuahuas need updated shots after one of their own becomes ill, an adorable puppy steals hearts around the clinic, and another young dog has an unusually large growth. Dr. Hodges helps an Alaskan malamute get its travel papers and attempts to bring a Pomeranian back from the brink. The docs leap into action, trying to save a canine bit by a venomous snake, and perform an emergency C-section to deliver five bulldog puppies.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: Dr. Oakley: Yukon Vet Compilations
programme.desc: Celebrate Women's History Month with a special compilation featuring the brains and brawn behind Dr. Michelle Oakley and her trio of vet assistant daughters. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol. Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs help a rare axolotl that hasn't eaten in six weeks, assist a tiny hamster with an enormous wound, investigate why a cat has become aggressive, perform surgery to fix a dog's hip joint, help a guinea pig with labored breathing, rehab a rooster after an attack, and are honored for their service to the community.

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.title: Dr. Oakley: Yukon Vet Compilations
programme.desc: Celebrate Women's History Month with a special compilation featuring the brains and brawn behind Dr. Michelle Oakley and her trio of vet assistant daughters. programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the constant heat, humidity and rainfall of the Australian rainforests to find out what it takes to be "Built to Survive." In the leafy canopy, Phil encounters the elusive tree kangaroo and its young joey, as well as Australia's largest snake, the lethal scrub python. On the forest floor, the colorful cassowary acts as the rainforest's gardener.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom

programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixer lend a helping paw to a variety of canine clients. programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Commissioner flips his lid, literally. His toupee blows off and sticks to Maurice, who also gets red cheeks and a skinned tail, all by accident. Julien and Mort chase him with sticks, intent on beating the "monster" stuck to Maurice's head. The baboon ladies take Maurice in, protecting and pampering him because they mistakenly think he's a male baboon. It's up to the penguins to get the toupee back and restore it to its rightful scalp. // Shelly the ostrich gets stuck in drying cement and only Rico can save her. Shelly falls for him hard as a result, however, Rico's heart forever belongs to his doll. Shelly swipes the doll and tries hard to win his heart, but Rico doesn't budge and his doll is accidently hauled off in a recycle truck. The penguins give chase but are left hopelessly in the dust. Shelly, wanting to make amends, tosses them on her back and sprints after the truck - can she possibly catch it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "HALF-HOUR SUMMER VACATION SPECIAL The penguin's worst nightmare has come true. After a sailing trip gone wrong they wind up in the Hoboken Zoo. Strangely, the animals are happy, the zoo is a paradise, and life couldn't be better! Zookeeper Frances takes outstanding care of all of them or does she? Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! A rescue comes from a very unlikely source, and the final battle could go either way!".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Bresto „Stade 29“ - Paryžiaus „Saint-Germain“
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. programme.title: Paternal Leave

programme.title: Speciale - Petra Terza Stagione
programme.desc: La terza stagione vede naturalmente protagonista Paola Cortellesi affiancata da Andrea Pennacchi. Entra in scena Francesco Acquaroli nel ruolo di Luigi, un poliziotto esperto e brillante che con Petra ha un legame speciale.

programme.title: Il cavaliere oscuro - Il ritorno
programme.desc: Ultimo capitolo della saga di Christopher Nolan con Christian Bale, Anne Hathaway, Marion Cotillard e Gary Oldman. Batman interrompe l'esilio per sventare il piano di un terrorista.

programme.title: L'ultima partita
programme.desc: Dave Bautista e Pierce Brosnan in un action terroristico. Londra: un gruppo di criminali progetta un attentato in uno stadio. Un ex militare è l'unico che può evitare la strage.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Quattro chiacchiere con Paola Cortellesi
programme.desc: L’attrice e regista si racconta a Gianni Canova: dagli esordi musicali al teatro, passando per la TV fino ad arrivare al cinema.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: Operation Fortune
programme.desc: Action Sky Original di Guy Ritchie con Jason Statham e Hugh Grant. Una spia dell'MI6 e il suo team di agenti reclutano una star di Hollywood per una missione sotto copertura.

programme.title: Senza sangue
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie dirige Salma Hayek in un intenso dramma ispirato al romanzo di Alessandro Baricco. Una donna ritrova dopo anni uno dei responsabili del massacro della sua famiglia e deve decidere come sia giusto vendicarsi.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulle migliori pellicole.

programme.title: Petra
programme.desc: Petra è alle prese con un nuovo, complicatissimo caso: un omicidio con furto di reliquia all'interno di un convento. Per venirne a capo, Petra e Antonio dovranno immergersi nel mondo dei furti d'arte e nella riservatissima comunità di suore.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb e' un paramedico di New York. Dopo un incidente scopre di essere chiaroveggente. Mentre cerca di risolvere il mistero sulle origini dei suoi poteri, si ritrova a difendere tre ragazze da uno spietato nemico.

programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf e Megan Fox nel primo capitolo della saga sci-fi prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Due razze aliene, gli Autobots e i Decepticons, scelgono la Terra come campo di battaglia.

programme.desc: Nick Hamm dirige Claes Bang nei panni del leggendario eroe in un imponente action tra storia e leggenda. Anno 1307: Gugliemo Tell, ex soldato delle Crociate abilissimo con la balestra, guida la nascente rivolta del popolo svizzero contro il dominio tirannico dell'Impero Austriaco.

programme.desc: Negli Stati Uniti infuocati da una sanguinosa guerra civile, Kirsten Dunst è la coraggiosa fotografa Lee che, insieme ad una collega e due giornalisti, intraprende un rischioso viaggio da New York a Washington per intervistare il Presidente.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar al reboot firmato Peter Jackson, con Naomi Watts, Jack Black e Adrien Brody. Anni '30: su un'isola remota una troupe di documentaristi si imbatte in un gigantesco gorilla.

programme.desc: Thriller con Mel Gibson nei panni di un Babbo Natale particolare. Santa Claus è in crisi e deve salvarsi dal killer assoldato da un perfido ragazzino, scontento del suo regalo.

programme.title: Nati stanchi
programme.desc: Prima commedia da protagonisti per Ficarra e Picone. Due giovani siciliani disoccupati e svogliati partecipano ai concorsi e si presentano ai colloqui facendo in modo di non essere assunti.

programme.title: Rob Peace
programme.desc: Un ragazzo geniale, cresciuto da una madre amorevole, mette a repentaglio i propri successi e il proprio futuro per liberare il padre, che è in prigione. Questa sua rischiosa impresa mette alla prova i legami familiari e le ambizioni personali.

programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Russell Crowe e Cate Blanchett. Tornato in patria dopo aver combattuto per l'Inghilterra, un arciere si ribella all'usurpatore del trono di re Riccardo I.

programme.title: Assassinio sull'Orient Express
programme.desc: Kenneth Branagh dirige un super cast con Michelle Pfeiffer, Penelope Cruz e Johnny Depp. Il detective Poirot indaga su un omicidio avvenuto su un treno. Dal bestseller di Agatha Christie.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: Clive Owen e Julia Roberts in una commedia intessuta di doppio gioco. Due spie industriali, ex agenti segreti ed ex amanti, uniscono i loro intenti per impadronirsi di una formula segreta.

programme.title: Se Dio vuole
programme.desc: Marco Giallini e Alessandro Gassmann nella commedia d'esordio di Edoardo Falcone. Un cardiochirurgo ateo entra in crisi quando il figlio annuncia di voler diventare sacerdote.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulle migliori pellicole.

programme.title: Eterno visionario
programme.desc: Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Bruni Tedeschi nel biopic che racconta vita e arte di Luigi Pirandello. Il ritratto intimo del grande drammaturgo e la cronaca della sua esistenza, scandita dal rapporto burrascoso con la moglie e dall'amore per una giovane musa.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: L’innocenza
programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Cannes 2023 per il delicato film di Hirokazu Kore'eda. Un preadolescente, vittima di un professore, è difeso dalla madre. Ma la verità è incerta.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: The Good House
programme.desc: Sigourney Weaver e Kevin Kline nel film dal romanzo di Ann Leary. Una vecchia fiamma che si riaccende costringe una valida agente immobiliare ad affrontare i suoi problemi di alcolismo.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Vermiglio
programme.desc: 7 David di Donatello per l'opera di Maura Delpero premiata anche a Venezia. La Seconda guerra mondiale volge al termine quando la stabilità di una famiglia trentina è stravolta.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: Il grande Steven Spielberg dirige i premi Oscar Anthony Hopkins e Morgan Freeman in un appassionante dramma storico-giudiziario. 1839: un gruppo di schiavi, imbarcati sulla nave Amistad per essere venduti, si ribellano e uccidono parte dell'equipaggio tentando il dirottamento verso l'Africa. Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: The Good House
programme.desc: Sigourney Weaver e Kevin Kline nel film dal romanzo di Ann Leary. Una vecchia fiamma che si riaccende costringe una valida agente immobiliare ad affrontare i suoi problemi di alcolismo.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige un intenso biopic con Tom Hanks. Dopo aver salvato i passeggeri del suo aereo con una coraggiosa manovra, nel 2009 il capitano Sullenberger fu messo sotto accusa.

programme.title: Settembre
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello all'opera prima di Giulia Steigerwalt con Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Barbara Ronchi. Al ritorno dalle vacanze si snodano i destini di tre personaggi pronti a cambiare vita.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Nel nostro cielo un rombo di tuono
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige un docu-film biografico sul campione Gigi Riva. Dall'infanzia alla gloria, la vita e la carriera del grande calciatore e il suo forte legame con la Sardegna.

programme.title: Nowhere Special - Una storia d'amore
programme.desc: Uberto Pasolini dirige un film struggente con James Norton e Daniel Lamont. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, John vuole trovare una famiglia per suo figlio di quattro anni.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Gugu Mbatha-Raw in un dramma storico. Guerra civile americana: un contadino si ribella ai soprusi dell'esercito confederato e crea uno stato indipendente.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Path to War - L'altro Vietnam
programme.desc: Ultimo film di John Frankenheimer, con Donald Sutherland vincitore del Golden Globe. Un ritratto inedito del presidente americano Lyndon Johnson nel pieno della guerra in Vietnam.

programme.title: Il seme del fico sacro
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Questione di tempo
programme.desc: Domhnall Gleeson e Rachel McAdams in una commedia romantica di Richard Curtis. A 21 anni Tim scopre di poter viaggiare nel tempo e usa questa abilita' per sistemare la sua vita.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: Caterina va in città
programme.desc: Commedia di Paolo Virzì con Margherita Buy e Sergio Castellitto. Giunta a Roma dalla provincia con i genitori, una timida tredicenne s'immerge nelle contraddizioni sociali della capitale.

programme.title: Il capitale umano
programme.desc: Paolo Virzì dirige Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Golino. Brianza: un incidente mortale segna il destino di due famiglie in un lento riaffiorare di segreti.

programme.title: Siccita'
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello al film di Paolo Virzi' con un grande cast corale. In una Roma in cui non piove da tre anni, fra divieti e disagi, si incrociano i destini di un gruppo di individui.

programme.title: La pazza gioia
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi e Micaela Ramazzotti nel road movie al femminile di Paolo Virzì. Due donne fuggono da una clinica psichiatrica e si avventurano a riassaporare il mondo.

programme.title: Quel maledetto film su Virzì
programme.desc: Tre documentaristi ossessionati da Paolo Virzi' inseguono per anni il regista per realizzare il film perfetto su di lui. Ma forze incontrollabili stravolgeranno i loro piani.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Le due Torri
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al secondo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson, dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Dopo la scissione della Compagnia dell'Anello, Gollum insegue Frodo e Sam, diretti a Mordor.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Il ritorno del Re
programme.desc: 11 Oscar al terzo capitolo della saga tolkeniana di Peter Jackson. Le forze di Sauron preparano l'attacco finale. Frodo e Sam si dirigono verso Monte Fato per distruggere l'Anello.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La guerra dei Rohirrim
programme.desc: Prodotto da Peter Jackson, il prequel in stile anime della trilogia de "Il Signore degli Anelli". Il Re Helm Hammerhand e il suo esercito organizzano un'ardua resistenza all'interno della Roccaforte di Hornburg per fronteggiare l'assalto di Wulf, Signore di Dunland, in cerca di vendetta dopo la morte del padre.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La compagnia dell'anello
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Un giovane hobbit entra in possesso di un anello dai poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Le due Torri
